description: Observed 900-active-second system probes with 33 versioned trials. Final 6 have stable matching source/assets SHA256; earlier 27 have unknown exact source. No human playtest or release-readiness claim.
limitations: Perfect aim; simple movement, no projectile prediction or manual dash.
No UI/menu time, quests, rarity gambling, currency exchange, combination or fusion decisions.
Nonstarter fixture gear is injected free; not an economy progression claim.
Damage dealt includes overkill, damage taken excludes shield absorption.
Early baseline snapshot preceded addition of managed policy output fields.
Three seeds only; reported ranges are not statistical confidence intervals.
Earlier 27 measurements omitted explicit forwarding of passive elemental/healing/critical bonuses and exact source fingerprints; final 6 forward those bonuses and luck-based trader bonuses.
